scope: Field-specific BICMR identity/founding/parent relationship and three dated appointment citations. Shared display fix across all 115 institution pages; not verification of all institutional histories or personnel.

findings.evidence: Official center introduction says established in 2005 as an independently constituted teaching and research unit of Peking University. The former 1898 university identity conflated parent and center.

Official introduction identifies Jingchun Garden and Langrun Garden, not the precise point previously copied into this center record. Old coordinates are preserved below; not asserted to be disproved.

Official faculty listings identify Fang Bohan as Professor, Xiaobo Liu as Professor, and Xu Xiaomeng as 副教授. Names matched their public institutional email/homepage and research areas. Read 2026-10-08; this is a dated source observation, not a guarantee of ongoing employment or a complete faculty roster.

Unsupported claims about who established a research direction, a school of thought and a seven-person HUST delegation are preserved verbatim below, without asserting their truth or falsity. Parent/center relationship now follows the official center introduction.

Counts share unique literal references from education, position, visit, group claims and dated citations. Last career rows, open-ended dates and old current_members cannot establish current appointments. Existing group lists remain unchanged and are shown as undated unverified records.

notes.before:
BICMR 是北大数学的国际研究中心。
徐晓濛在此建立了 Stokes phenomenon / quantum groups 研究方向。
刘小博培养的 GW 理论群体（王新、杨成浪、邬龙挺、王崇宇 [待验证]）
是国内该方向的重要学派。
2026 HUST 会议北大派出 7 人代表团。
notes.after:
中心于 2005 年设立，隶属北京大学，并作为独立教学科研单位运行。
办公地点分布在镜春园、朗润园。该条目记录 BICMR，学校整体另见北京大学条目。

notes.before:
北京大学数学科学学院是国内数学研究的顶级机构之一。
BICMR（北京国际数学研究中心）是其国际化研究平台，单独建档 pku-bicmr。
刘小博的 Gromov-Witten 学派（王新、杨成浪、邬龙挺等）是本平台核心追踪对象。
notes.after:
该条目对应北京大学整体。北京国际数学研究中心（BICMR）是北京大学独立设置的教学科研单位，另有独立条目。
学校、数学科学学院和 BICMR 的人员名单需要分别核对，不能直接相互替代。
